Language scholars Ammon Hillman and Luke Gorton join Danny Jones to argue that the Vatican hides the truth about Jesus. Both men read the oldest Greek and Latin texts. Their claim is that the church buried the first form of the faith.

The guests walk through words and lines they say the church bent or hid. They argue drugs and rites sat at the heart of the first church. Jones asks how other scholars read the same lines. Listeners get a deep, sharp claim made by two men who read the sources in the raw tongue. The library files it as an archive record.
podcast-joerogan-WUYhCmfE1a0:
Aerospace businessman Robert Bigelow tells Bob Lazar stories in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. Bigelow spent part of his fortune on UFO research, funding studies and buying the famous Skinwalker Ranch. His path crossed Lazar's early, when the claims were new.

Rogan draws out what Bigelow heard and saw in those years, and how much of Lazar's account the rich researcher credits. The talk also opens onto Bigelow's wider hunt: government contracts, secret files, and his own beliefs. The segment links two of UFO culture's central figures in one conversation, and it preserves rare first-hand color.
